bio: The Koneser Grill's location is one of its many appealing qualities, set inside the Centrum Praskie Koneser, an old vodka distillery that has been transformed into a mini walled village where apartments, shops, art venues and a museum now sit beside one another. The restaurant comes from the same owners as Butchery & Wine and its grill-centric menu offers a range of quality steaks that have been aged in-house, but everything on the list – from the salad to the Basque cheesecake – is equally enjoyable. Sharing is the way to go for the best value experience and the kitchen team aim to use every part of the ingredients, with no waste....
